lines: He broke a poor man's boat… to save it.
Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam, asked: Have you torn it open to drown its people?
Then came the reason: I damaged it, because a king was seizing every ship by force.
The damage you can't understand today... may be what saves you. Send this to someone who needs it.

beats.text: He broke a poor man's boat… to save it.
beats.ur: انہوں نے غریبوں کی کشتی توڑی… اسے بچانے کے لیے

beats.text: “Have you torn it open to drown its people?”
beats.ur: کیا آپ نے اسے اس لیے پھاڑا کہ اس کے لوگوں کو ڈبو دیں؟

beats.en: So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force

beats.ur: اسی نقصان نے اسے بچا لیا

beats.text: The damage you can't understand today… may be what saves you.
beats.ur: جو نقصان آج سمجھ نہیں آتا… شاید وہی آپ کو بچا رہا ہو

scenes.style: High-quality 3D animated feature film still, close to photoreal (modern big-studio animation look), rich detail, cinematic lighting and depth of field. Vertical 9:16, keep the top third fairly simple and dark-to-plain (text sits there), the action in the lower two thirds. An ancient sea coast long ago. Absolutely no prophet or holy figure shown; no person close up.

scenes.s5: A bright calm sea at sunrise with a small repaired fishing boat sailing safely, birds over the water, hopeful golden light. ABSOLUTELY NO PEOPLE, no human figures, no silhouettes on the shore or in the boat.
